one_line: Kakatiya queen regnant of Warangal, a formidable 13th‑century ruler and battlefield leader.

appearance.face: oval face with strong jawline, medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, a straight nose, and a small healed scar on the left cheek; default expression calm, authoritative, with a steady, assessing gaze
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted in the middle, drawn back into a long, tight braid reaching mid-back, wrapped at the crown with a gold Kakatiya-style cylindrical coronet and secured by a red cloth band; a few short strands frame her temples
appearance.costume: over a fitted short-sleeved red tunic (angiya), she wears a knee-length scale-mail vest in dulled steel tones edged with narrow gold trim; a deep indigo cotton dhoti-style lower garment is wrapped firmly and pleated to the front, reaching the ankles, worn over simple brown leather boots; across her chest and shoulder runs a broad saffron silk sash from left shoulder to right hip, slightly weathered at the edges; jewelry is dignified but practical—medium-sized gold hoop earrings, a single gold armlet on the right upper arm with a subtle floral motif, a sturdy gold necklace with a central circular pendant resting just below the collarbone, and a thin gold waist belt over the sash to control the drape; no excessive ornament, all items look courtly yet battlefield-ready
appearance.signature: a long, slightly curved steel sword modeled on a Deccan talwar, with a simple disc pommel, protective knuckle guard, and a dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, carried in a plain dark leather scabbard at her left hip and often held unsheathed in her right hand

ref_desc: Rudrama Devi is a mid-30s, athletic, medium-brown queen with an oval strong-jawed face, long braided black hair under a gold coronet, red tunic, steel scale-mail vest, indigo dhoti, saffron sash, gold jewelry, and a curved steel talwar sword in a dark scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Rudrama Devi: a mid-30s, athletic Kakatiya queen with a medium-brown Deccan complexion, an oval strong-jawed face, sharp dark eyes, and a calm authoritative expression, wearing long black hair in a tight braid to mid-back, topped with a cylindrical gold coronet wrapped at the base with a red cloth band and a few loose strands at the temples. Show her in a fitted short-sleeved red tunic, covered by a knee-length dull steel scale-mail vest edged with narrow gold trim, and a deep indigo dhoti-style lower garment wrapped and pleated to the front, reaching her ankles over simple brown leather boots. Across her torso and shoulder depict a broad saffron silk sash from left shoulder to right hip, held in place by a thin gold waist belt. Add medium gold hoop earrings, a single gold armlet with a subtle floral motif on the right upper arm, and a sturdy gold necklace with a round pendant below the collarbone, all looking courtly yet practical. At her left hip show a plain dark leather scabbard holding a long, slightly curved steel talwar with a disc pommel, knuckle guard, and brown leather-wrapped hilt, also illustrated unsheathed in her hand in at least one pose. Emphasize the deep indigo, saffron, rich red, dull steel grey, and warm gold color palette, and present multiple views to clearly show her face, braid, coronet, armor, garments, jewelry, boots, and sword details.
